title: Wide-field view of Messier 9 (ground-based image)
description: This image from the Digitized Sky Survey 2 shows a wide-field view of globular cluster Messier 9 and its surroundings, imaged by a ground-based telescope. The dark patches are clouds of interstellar dust. Immediately to the right of Messier 9 is the dark cloud Barnard 64.
credit: NASA, ESA, Digitized Sky Survey 2 (Acknowledgement: Davide De Martin)
name: Messier 9
